problem.h: You were sure you’d never forget it
p: The made-up words, the mispronunciations, the accidentally wise things they say at bath time. In the moment you think you’ll remember forever.
Then they grow out of it, and one day you realise you can’t quite remember how they used to say it. A note on your phone doesn’t feel like enough.

approach.h: One place for all their little words
p: This archive gives every saying its own page, with room for when it happened, how old they were, where you were and why you want to remember it.
Years from now, it’s the book you’ll read together and laugh at, and maybe the one they keep for their own children.

offer.h: A keepsake that grows with them
offer.p: Simple, beautiful pages, so writing something down takes a minute.
features: Pages for the words they invented, said differently, or used in a way that was only theirs.
When, how old they were, where you were and what was happening.
Lined pages to write to them, for a day when these words are read again.

proof.p: Navy, sage and soft paper tones, made to look lovely on a shelf for years.
note: I made this because the things children say are some of the best bits of having them around, and they disappear so quickly.
You don’t need to be a writer. A date, their age and the words themselves are enough.

items: Pages for words they invented or said their own way
Big boxes for the things they once said
“About this moment” pages: when, how old, where and why
A note for the future, for when the words are read again

decision.h: Paperback or hardcover, it’s your choice
decision.price_note: paperback, at the time of writing
points: The paperback is lighter and easy to keep in a kitchen drawer.
The hardcover is sturdier, a good choice for a gift or a book meant to last years.
Both have exactly the same pages, printed and delivered by Amazon.

faq: It’s for the grown-up to fill in, from the first words in toddlerhood right through the funny things primary school children come out with.
Should I choose the paperback or the hardcover?
The pages are the same. Choose hardcover for a gift or if you want it to last on a shelf for years, and paperback if you’d like it lighter and a little cheaper.
Is it a good baby shower gift?
Yes. It’s a gift that comes into its own a year or two later, once the first words arrive, and it doesn’t date.
Can I use it for more than one child?
You can, by writing their name with each entry, but most families like one book per child so each one has their own keepsake.
Amazon sometimes offers gift options at checkout. Otherwise it arrives ready for you to wrap.

close.h: Write down the next funny thing they say
close.p: You’ll be so glad you did.
